policy_registry.title: Queensland Clinical Guideline: Normal birth
policy_registry.scope_note: Guideline addresses normal birth and its flowcharts specify low-risk woman at term; it is not a general roster or all-acuity site staffing standard.

policy_registry.title: Queensland Clinical Guideline: Intrapartum fetal surveillance
policy_registry.scope_note: Queensland maternity and neonatal practice guidance. Policy reference only; no eligibility logic or service turnaround target is encoded here.
policy_registry.version_note: The guideline history records V11 on 2026-09-04 and V12 on 2026-09-25. The currently linked PDF identifies V12 and says it replaces V11; the current PDF cover and later history entry agree.

policy_registry.title: Queensland Clinical Guideline: Instrumental vaginal birth
policy_registry.scope_note: Guideline index shows this revision in October 2026. The PDF states clinician expertise and a neonatal-resuscitation-trained clinician are required in the described procedure context; this is not a complete staffing model.

policy_registry.title: Queensland Clinical Guideline: Prolonged and/or obstructed labour
policy_registry.scope_note: Current indexed clinical guideline; no thresholds are imported into this reference profile.

previous_pregnancies.note: This is the report's number-of-previous-pregnancies field; it is not relabelled as a universal parity definition.

labour_onset.note: The source distinguishes no labour from established spontaneous/induced labour; failed induction resulting in caesarean is classified as no labour in QPDC definitions.

cross_tab_notes: Table 6.05 reports method by singleton/multiple status; the aggregate table contains selected joint counts but not linked person histories.
Table 6.12 reports selected labour-onset by birth-method counts; these do not identify time-to-event hazards or full joint dependence.

staffing.source_boundary: The QPDC aggregate tables do not describe site rosters, shift overlap, skill mix, breaks, call-in delay, occupancy, or contemporaneous effective staffing. QCG Normal birth refers to one-to-one midwifery support in its low-risk-at-term context, not a general service-wide ratio.

eligibility.reason: Applicability depends on the selected care setting, service capabilities, population, clinical governance and scope. Current source revisions are indexed; no local clinical rule is inferred from the generic track.

operational_timing_targets.time_unit: minutes when a future source-qualified target is selected
operational_timing_targets.reason: The current policy registry does not establish one generic operational decision-to-transfer, incision, delivery, or staffing-response target for an unspecified birthing site. Clinical assessment/monitoring intervals and labour-stage definitions are not silently converted into service turnaround targets. Earlier 30/75-minute and parity/duration examples remain unadopted hypotheses.

unknown_or_unresolved: joint dependence among population attributes, onset, intervention, progression, route and outcomes

synthetic_assumptions.note: Synthetic assumptions belong in a separately identified fixture and must not be merged into observed aggregates or policy metadata.
